name: Cana

related_people.name: Nathanael
related_people.role: a Galilean of this town, won over when Jesus showed supernatural knowledge of him

description: A Galilean town where Jesus performed His first public miracle, turning water into wine at a wedding (John 2:1-11); Nathanael was from Cana (John 21:2).
family_friendly_summary: Cana was a town in Galilee where Jesus did His very first miracle. At a wedding there, the hosts ran out of wine, so Jesus quietly turned six large jars of water into wine. His disciple Nathanael came from Cana.
